name: Copper Morning
my_thoughts: Wears like a clean morning and disappears after three hours, which I have decided to forgive because the first thirty minutes are the best thirty minutes I own.

name: Salt Flat
my_thoughts: Bought it on holiday and it only works on holiday. At home it smells like a hotel corridor, which is a lesson about buying anything in a good mood.

name: Patina
my_thoughts: Far too much for a Tuesday and exactly right for a cold night out. Two sprays is a costume; one is a decision.
